Elias folded the paper carefully, then climbed to the lamp room and watched the horizon for a figure who might never come.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚冷却的机器。高楼只剩轮廓，街灯把雾气染成淡金色。清洁车缓慢驶过空旷的马路，水痕在地面闪着微光。便利店还醒着，店员靠在收银台边打盹。远处偶尔传来一声汽笛，很快又被夜色吞没。有人在窗后关掉最后一盏灯，也有人已经系好鞋带，准备赶第一班地铁。此刻的城市并不安静，它只是把喧闹收进了更深的呼吸里，等待天亮。","w03":"• Recursion is when a helper does a small part of a job and then asks a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• You need a stopping rule, like 'if the box is empty, stop,' so the smaller copies know when to finish.\n• It’s like opening nested boxes: open one, then use the same trick on the box inside, until you reach the tiny prize."}
